heroes.summary: To effectively counter Abrams in Deadlock, you must focus on neutralizing his melee pressure and massive health sustain. Abrams players look to bait parries with heavy melee animations; counter this by building Spirit Burn early to negate his health-drain and utilizing Rebuttal to win parry trades. Avoid close engagements until your damage can outburst his siphon bullets.
lanePhase: Bait his parry by looking away during heavy melee animations.
Rebuttal cuts parry cooldown from 4s to 2s, punishing his light spam.
Avoid close quarters trades; his passive sustain wins long brawls early.
Farm safely near your guardian to force him to overextend for trades.

situations.label: He is healing through all your damage
situations.reason: Buy Spirit Burn or Toxic Bullets early. Provides the largest healing reduction in the game (-70%) to stop his massive sustain.

situations.label: Getting run down by charge and melee combos
situations.reason: Use Rebuttal to win melee trades. It cuts parry cooldown by half, returning damage to him while granting bonus health.

situations.label: Getting CC'd and bursted late game
situations.reason: Upgrade Reactive Barrier to Indomitable. Automatically cleanses the Shoulder Charge stun, breaking his ability combo instantly.
